Then Joab blew the ram’s horn, and the troops broke off their pursuit of Israel because Joab had restrained them.
The battle raged throughout that day, and the king was propped up in his chariot facing the Arameans. And the blood from his wound ran out onto the floor of the chariot, and that evening he died.

That is not the case. But a man named Sheba son of Bichri, from the hill country of Ephraim, has lifted up his hand against the king, against David. Deliver him alone, and I will depart from the city.” “Look,” the woman replied, “his head will be thrown to you over the wall.”

verses.text: In this way God repaid the wickedness that Abimelech had done to his father in murdering his seventy brothers.

xrefs.text: He will bring upon them their own iniquity and destroy them for their wickedness. The LORD our God will destroy them.
The iniquities of a wicked man entrap him; the cords of his sin entangle him.
The righteous will rejoice when they see they are avenged; they will wash their feet in the blood of the wicked.
Do not be deceived: God is not to be mocked. Whatever a man sows, he will reap in return.
For with the same judgment you pronounce, you will be judged, and with the measure you use, it will be measured to you.

verses.text: And God also brought all the wickedness of the men of Shechem back upon their own heads. So the curse of Jotham son of Jerubbaal came upon them.

xrefs.text: But if not, may fire come from Abimelech and consume the leaders of Shechem and Beth-millo, and may fire come from the leaders of Shechem and Beth-millo and consume Abimelech.”

In Ahab’s days, Hiel the Bethelite rebuilt Jericho. At the cost of Abiram his firstborn he laid its foundation, and at the cost of Segub his youngest he set up its gates, according to the word that the LORD had spoken through Joshua son of Nun.
And all that day Abimelech fought against the city until he had captured it and killed its people. Then he demolished the city and sowed it with salt.

At that time Joshua invoked this solemn oath: “Cursed before the LORD is the man who rises up and rebuilds this city, Jericho; at the cost of his firstborn he will lay its foundations; at the cost of his youngest he will set up its gates.”
